s.d: Ἀμών, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָמוֹן), Amon, King of Judah: [[matthew 1 10|Mat.1:10]] (Rec.).† (AS)

Ἀμώς, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָמוֹץ, [[isaiah 1 1|Isa.1:1;]] עָמוֹס, [[amos 1 1|Amo.1:1;]] אָמוֹן, [[2-kings 21 18|4Ki.21:18]] ff. B) 1. as in 2Ki, Lc. B (Α. Ἀμμών; Jos., Ἀμμών, "Αμωσσς), Amon: [[matthew 1 10|Mat.1:10.]] 2. Amos: [[luke 3 25|Luk.3:25.]]† (AS)

Ἀμώς, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָמוֹץ, [[isaiah 1 1|Isa.1:1;]] עָמוֹס, [[amos 1 1|Amo.1:1;]] אָמוֹן, [[2-kings 21 18|4Ki.21:18]] ff. B) 1. as in 2Ki, Lc. B (Α. Ἀμμών; Jos., Ἀμμών, "Αμωσσς), Amon: [[matthew 1 10|Mat.1:10.]] 2. Amos: [[luke 3 25|Luk.3:25.]]† (AS)

ἄν, conditional particle, which cannot usually be separately translated in English, its force depending on the constructions which contain it (see further, LS, see word; WM, §xlii; M, Pr., 165 ff.; MM, VGT, see word). 1. In apodosis, (i) with indic, imperfect or aor., expressing what would be or would have been if (εἰ with impf., aor. or plpf.) some condition were or had been fulfilled: [[luke 7 39|Luk.7:39 17:6]], [[john 5 46|Jhn.5:46]], [[galatians 1 10|Gal.1:10]], [[matthew 12 7|Mat.12:7 24:43]], [[1-corinthians 2 8|1Co.2:8]], [[acts 18 14|Act.18:14]], [[1-john 2 19|1Jn.2:19]], al. The protasis is sometimes understood (as also in cl.): [[matthew 25 27|Mat.25:27]], [[luke 19 23|Luk.19:23]]. In hypothetical sentences, expressing unreality, ἄν (as often in late writers, more rarely in cl.) is omitted: [[john 8 39|Jhn.8:39 15:24 19:11]], [[romans 7 7|Rom.7:7]], [[galatians 4 15|Gal.4:15]]; (ii) with opt., inf., ptcp. (cl.; see LS, see word; M, Int., §275; M, Pr., 167:4). 2. In combination with conditional, relative, temporal, and final words; (i) as in cl., with subj., (a) in protasis with εἰ, in Attic contr. ἐάν, which see; (b) in conditional, relative, and temporal clauses (coalescing with ὅτε, ἐπεί, etc.; see: ὅταν, ἐπάν, etc.), ever, soever; (α) with pres., ἡνίκα, [[2-corinthians 3 15|2Co.3:15;]] ὃς ἄν, [[romans 9 15|Rom.9:15]] (LXX) 16:2, al.; ὅσοι ἄν, [[luke 9 5|Luk.9:5;]] ὡς ἄν, [[romans 15 24|Rom.15:24]] (M, Pr., 167); (β) with aor., ὃς ἄν, [[matthew 5 21|Mat.5:21, 22, 31]]; ἕως ἄν, until, [[matthew 2 13|Mat.2:13]], [[mark 6 10|Mrk.6:10]], al.; ὡς ἄν, as soon as (M, Pr., 167), [[1-corinthians 11 34|1Co.11:34]], [[philippians 2 23|Php.2:23]]. On the frequently use of ἐάν for ἄν with the foregoing words, see: ἐάν; (ii) in late Gk., when some actual fact is spoken of, with indic.: ὅταν (which see); ὅπου ἄν, [[mark 6 56|Mrk.6:56]] (M, Pr., 168); καθότι ἄν, [[acts 2 45|Act.2:45 4:35]]; ὡς ἄν, [[1-corinthians 12 2|1Co.12:2.]] 3. in iterative construction, with imperfect and aor. indic. (M, Pr., 167): [[acts 2 45|Act.2:45 4:35]], [[1-corinthians 12 2|1Co.12:2]]. 4. with optative, giving a potential sense to a question or wish: [[acts 8 31|Act.8:31 26:29]]. 5. Elliptical constructions: εἰ μή τι ἄν (M, Pr., 169), [[1-corinthians 7 5|1Co.7:5;]] ὡς ἄν, with inf., as it were (op. cit. 167), [[2-corinthians 10 9|2Co.10:9.]] (AS)

ἀνά prep. (the rarest in NT; M, Pr., 98; MM, VGT, see word), prop., upwards, up, always with accusative 1. In phrases: ἀ. μέσον, among, between, with genitive, [[matthew 13 1|Mat.13:1-58 25:1-46]], [[mark 7 31|Mrk.7:31]], [[1-corinthians 6 5|1Co.6:5]] (M, Pr., 99), [[revelation 7 17|Rev.7:17]] [so in LXX for בְּתוׄך׃]; ἀ. μέρος, in turn, [[1-corinthians 14 27|1Co.14:27]] (both found in Polyb.; cf. MGr. ἀνάμεσα). 2. Distrib., apiece, by: [[matthew 20 9|Mat.20:9-10]], [[luke 9 3|Luk.9:3]] (WH om.), [[luke 9 14|Luk.9:14]] [[luke 10 1|Luk.10:1]], [[john 2 6|Jhn.2:6]], [[revelation 4 8|Rev.4:8]]. 3. Adverbially ("a vulgarism," B1., § 51, 5; cf. Deiss., BS, 139 f.), ἀ. εἷς ἕκαστος, [[revelation 21 21|Rev.21:21.]] As prefix, ἀ. signifies (a) up: ἀναβαίνειν; (b) to: ἀναγγέλλειν; (with) anew: ἀναγεννᾶν; (d) back: ἀνακάμπτειν.† (AS)

ἀνα-βαθμός, -οῦ, ὁ (ἀναβαίνω), [in LXX for מַעֲלָה: מַעֲלָה: [[1-kings 10 19|3Ki.10:19-20]], [[2-kings 9 13|4Ki.9:13 20:9]] ff, [[2-chronicles 9 18|2Ch.9:18-19]], [[isaiah 38 8|Isa.38:8]], [[ezekiel 40 6|Eze.40:6, 49]]; ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀ., tit. [[psalms 120 1|Psa.120:1-7 121:1-8 122:1-9 123:1-4 124:1-8 125:1-5 126:1-6 127:1-5 128:1-6 129:1-8 130:1-8 131:1-3 132:1-18 133:1-3 134:1-3]])* ;] 1. a going up, an ascent (Pss, ll. with ?). 2. a step (LXX); p1., a flight of stairs: [[acts 21 35|Act.21:35, 40]]. (On the formation -θμός, see MM, VGT, see word)† (AS)

ἀναβαίνω [in LXX chiefly for עָלָה ;] to go up, ascend, (a) of persons: ἐπί συκομωρέαν, [[luke 19 4|Luk.19:4;]] εἰς τ. πλοῖον, [[mark 6 51|Mrk.6:51;]] εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, [[matthew 20 17|Mat.20:17;]] εἰς τ. ἱερόν, with inf. (M, Pr., 205), [[luke 18 10|Luk.18:10;]] with mention of place of departure, [[matthew 3 16|Mat.3:16]] (ἀπό), [[acts 8 39|Act.8:39]] (ἐκ); (b) of things, to rise, spring up, come up: a fish, [[matthew 17 27|Mat.17:27;]] smoke, [[revelation 8 4|Rev.8:4;]] plants growing, [[matthew 13 7|Mat.13:7;]] metaphorically, of things coming up in one's mind (as Heb. לֵב אֵל עָלָה; 4Ki.12:4, al.), [[luke 24 38|Luk.24:38]], [[1-corinthians 2 9|1Co.2:9]]; of prayers, [[acts 10 4|Act.10:4;]] messages, [[acts 21 31|Act.21:31]] (for late exx., see MM, VGT, see word) (AS)

ἀνα-βάλλω [in LXX: [[psalms 78 21|Psa.78:21 89:38]] (עָבַר), [[1-kings 28 14|1Ki.28:14]], [[psalms 104 2|Psa.104:2]] (עָטָה) ;] to defer, put off (MM, VGT, see word): mid., [[acts 24 22|Act.24:22.]]† (AS)

ἀνα-βιβάζω (causal of ἀναβαίνω), [in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi., also for רָכַב hi., etc. ;] to make go up, draw up, as a ship (Xen.): σαγήνην, [[matthew 13 48|Mat.13:48]] (metaphorically, MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀνα-βλέπω [in LXX chiefly for נָשָׂא ;] 1. to look up: [[mark 8 24|Mrk.8:24]], al.; before εἰς, [[matthew 14 19|Mat.14:19]], al. (Xen., Plat.). 2. to recover sight (Plat., Aristoph.; cf. MM, VGT, see word): [[matthew 11 5|Mat.11:5]], [[john 9 11|Jhn.9:11]], al (AS)
ἀνά-βλεψις, -εως, ή (ἀναβλέπω), [in LXX: [[isaiah 61 1|Isa.61:1]] (פְּקַח־קוֹחַ)* ;] recovery of sight: [[luke 4 18|Luk.4:18]] (Lxx).† (AS)
ἀνα-βοάω, -ῶ [in LXX for צָעַק, זָעַק, קָרָא, etc. ;] to cry out: [[matthew 27 46|Mat.27:46]] (WH, ἐβόησεν; see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀναβολή, - ῆς, ἡ (ά αβάλλω), [in LXX for בּנף, etc. ;] delay: [[acts 25 17|Act.25:17]] (for exx. of other meanings, see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀν-αγγέλλω [in LXX chiefly for נָגַד hi ;] 1. to bring back word, report (Æsch., Thuc., al.): [[john 5 15|Jhn.5:15]] (WH, εἶπεν), [[acts 14 27|Act.14:27 15:4]], [[2-corinthians 7 7|2Co.7:7]] 2. Later, = ἀπαγγέλλω (MM, VGT, see word), to announce, declare (LXX; Cremer, 24): [[matthew 28 11|Mat.28:11]] (WH, ἀπ-), [[john 4 25|Jhn.4:25 16:13-15]], [[acts 19 18|Act.19:18 20:20, 27]] [[romans 15 21|Rom.15:21]], [[1-peter 1 12|1Pe.1:12]], [[1-john 1 5|1Jn.1:5]].† (AS)
ἀνα-γεννάω, -ῶ [in LXX: Sir prol.17 א* (ΑΒאc παρα-)* ;] to beget again: metaphorically, of spiritual birth, [[1-peter 1 3|1Pe.1:3 1:23]] (cf. Cremer, 147; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀνα-γινώσκω (Attic ἀναγιγν-), [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;] 1. to know certainly, know again, recognize. 2. Of written characters, to read: [[matthew 24 15|Mat.24:15]], [[mark 13 14|Mrk.13:14]], [[acts 15 31|Act.15:31 23:34]], [[ephesians 3 4|Eph.3:4]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 22 31|Mat.22:31]], [[mark 12 10|Mrk.12:10]] [[luke 6 3|Luk.6:3]], [[john 19 20|Jhn.19:20]], [[acts 8 30|Act.8:30, 32]], [[2-corinthians 1 13|2Co.1:13]], [[revelation 1 3|Rev.1:3]]; with accusative of person(s), Ἠσαίαν τ. προφήτην, [[acts 8 28|Act.8:28, 30]]; before ἐν, [[matthew 12 5|Mat.12:5 21:42]], [[mark 12 26|Mrk.12:26]] (so. ἐν τ. νόμῳ), [[luke 10 26|Luk.10:26;]] before ὅτι, [[matthew 19 4|Mat.19:4 21:16]]; τί ἐποίησε, [[matthew 12 3|Mat.12:3]], [[mark 2 25|Mrk.2:25]]; pass. [[2-corinthians 3 2|2Co.3:2;]] of reading aloud (MM, VGT, see word), [[luke 4 16|Luk.4:16]], [[acts 13 27|Act.13:27 15:21]], [[2-corinthians 3 15|2Co.3:15]], [[colossians 4 16|Col.4:16]], [[1-thessalonians 5 27|1Th.5:27]] (M, Th., in l).† (AS)

ἀναγκάζω (ἀνάγκη), [in LXX: [[proverbs 6 7|Pro.6:7]] (שֹׁטֵר), I [[esther 3 24|Est.3:24]], 1Ma.2:25, al. ;] to necessitate, compel by force or persuasion, constrain: with accusative, [[2-corinthians 12 11|2Co.12:11;]] id. with inf., [[matthew 14 22|Mat.14:22]], [[mark 6 45|Mrk.6:45]], [[luke 14 23|Luk.14:23]], [[acts 26 11|Act.26:11]] (on the imperfect here, see Field, Notes, 141; M, Pr., 128 f., 247), [[galatians 2 14|Gal.2:14 6:12]]; pass., C. inf., [[acts 28 19|Act.28:19]], [[galatians 2 3|Gal.2:3]] (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀναγκαῖος, -αῖα, -αῖον (ἀνάγκη), [in LXX: [[esther 8 13|Est.8:13]], Wis.16:3, Sir prol.22, 2Ma.4:23 2Mac 9:21, 4Ma.1:2 * ;] 1. necessary: [[acts 13 46|Act.13:46]], [[1-corinthians 12 22|1Co.12:22]], [[2-corinthians 9 5|2Co.9:5]], [[philippians 2 25|Php.2:25]], [[titus 3 14|Tit.3:14]], [[hebrews 8 3|Heb.8:3]]; comp. -αιότερον, [[philippians 1 24|Php.1:24.]] 2. Of persons connected by bonds of nature or friendship, near, intimate (Field, Notes, 118; ΜΜ, VGT, see word): ἀ. φίλοι, [[acts 10 24|Act.10:24.]]† (AS)
ἀναγκαστῶς adv., necessarily or by constraint: opposite to ἑκουσίως, [[1-peter 5 2|1Pe.5:2]] (rare).† (AS)

ἀνάγκη, -ης, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for מָצוֹק, צַר ;] 1. necessity: ἔχειν ἀ-, with inf., to be compelled, [[luke 14 18|Luk.14:18 23:17]] (Rec., R, mg.), [[1-corinthians 7 37|1Co.7:37]], Ju 3, [[hebrews 7 27|Heb.7:27]]; ἐξ ἀ., κατ᾽ ἀ., of necessity, [[2-corinthians 9 7|2Co.9:7]], [[hebrews 7 12|Heb.7:12]], Phm 14; ἀ. μοι ἐπίκειται, n. is laid on me, [[1-corinthians 9 16|1Co.9:16;]] with inf. (= ἀναγκαῖον ἐστι), [[matthew 18 7|Mat.18:7]], [[romans 13 5|Rom.13:5]], [[hebrews 9 16|Heb.9:16, 23]] 2. force, violence, hence pain, distress (Diod., al.; LXX; see M, Th., 41; MM, VGT, see word; cf. θλίψις): [[luke 21 23|Luk.21:23]], [[1-corinthians 7 26|1Co.7:26]], [[1-thessalonians 3 7|1Th.3:7]]; pl. (see B1., § 32, 6; Swete, Mk., 153), ἐν ἀ., [[2-corinthians 6 4|2Co.6:4 12:10]].† (AS)
ἀνα-γνωρίζω [in LXX: [[genesis 45 1|Gen.45:1]] (יָדַע hith.)* ;] to recognize: [[acts 7 13|Act.7:13]] (WH, txt., ἐγνωρίσθη).† (AS)

ἀνά-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ [in LXX: [[nehemiah 8 8|Neh.8:8]] (מִקְרָא), I [[esther 9 48|Est.9:48]], Sir prol. 9, 13 * ;] 1. recognition (Hdt.). 2. reading (Plat., al.): of the public reading of Scripture (Milligan, NTD, 173, 210 f.): [[acts 13 15|Act.13:15]], [[2-corinthians 3 14|2Co.3:14]], [[1-timothy 4 13|1Ti.4:13]] (Cremer, 158; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀν-άγω [in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi. ;] to lead or bring up: before είς, with accusative loc., [[matthew 4 1|Mat.4:1]], [[luke 2 22|Luk.2:22 4:5]] (WH om. είς, κ.τ.λ.), [[acts 9 39|Act.9:39 16:34]]; of raising the dead (cl.), ἐκ νεκρῶν, [[romans 10 7|Rom.10:7]], [[hebrews 13 20|Heb.13:20]]; to produce and set before, τ. λαῷ, [[acts 12 4|Act.12:4]] (MM, VGT, see word); in sacrificial sense (MM, 1 with), to offer, θυσίαν, [[acts 7 41|Act.7:41.]] Mid., in nautical sense (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.), to put to sea: [[luke 8 22|Luk.8:22]], [[acts 13 13|Act.13:13 16:11 18:21 20:3, 13 21:1-2 27:2, 4 27:12, 21 28:10-11]] (cf.ἐπ-ανάγω).† (AS)

ἀνα-δείκνυμι [in LXX: [[habakkuk 3 2|Hab.3:2]] (יָדַע), Dan LXX 1:11 (מָנָה), [[daniel 1 20|Dan.1:20]] (מָצָא), 1Esdra.6.2, 3Mac.9 * ;] 1. to lift up and show, show forth, declare (cf. 2Ma.2:8, see MM, VGT, see word): [[acts 1 24|Act.1:24.]] 2. to consecrate, set apart, (Strab., Plut., Anth.): [[luke 10 1|Luk.10:1.]]† (AS)
ἀνά-δειξις, -εως, ἡ (ἀναδείκνυμι), [in LXX: Sir.43:6 * ;] a sheaving forth, announcement: [[luke 1 80|Luk.1:80.]]† (AS)

ἀνα-δέχομαι [in LXX: 2Ma.6:19 2Mac 8:36 * ;] 1. to assume, undertake (in π. frequently as legal term: MM, VGT, see word): ἐπαγγελίας, [[hebrews 11 17|Heb.11:17.]] 2. = cl. ὑποδέχομαι, to receive: of guests, [[acts 28 7|Act.28:7.]]† (AS)
ἀνα-δίδωμι [in LXX: Sir.1:22, 2Ma.13:15 * ;] 1. to give forth, send up, as of plants (Hdt., al.). 2. to give up, yield, hand over (MM, VGT, see word): [[acts 23 33|Act.23:33.]]† (AS)

ἀνα-ζάω, -ῶ [in Al.: [[genesis 45 27|Gen.45:27]] * ;] to live again, regain life (cf. cl. ἀναβιόω; Cremer, 722; and for other exx., v MM, VGT, see word): metaphorically of moral revival, [[luke 15 24|Luk.15:24]] (WH, mg., ἔζησεν); of sin, [[romans 7 9|Rom.7:9.]]† (AS)

ἀνα-ζητέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[job 3 4|Job.3:4]] (דָּרַשׁ), [[job 10 6|Job.10:6]] (בָּקַשׁ pi.), 2Ma.13:21 * ;] to look for or seek carefully ("specially of searching for human beings, with an implication of difficulty": MM, VGT, see word): [[luke 2 44|Luk.2:44-45]] [[acts 11 25|Act.11:25]].† (AS)
ἀνα-ζώννυμι [in LXX: [[judges 18 16|Jdg.18:16]], [[proverbs 31 17|Pro.31:17]] (חָגַר)* ;] to gird up: figuratively, τ. ὀσφύας τ. διανοίας, [[1-peter 1 13|1Pe.1:13.]]† (AS)
ἀνα-ζωπυργέω, -ῶ (ζωός, πῦρ), [in LXX: 1Ma.13:7 * ;] to kindle afresh: metaphorically, [[2-timothy 1 6|2Ti.1:6]] (for vernac. exx., see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀνα-θάλλω (θάλλω, to flourish), [in LXX: [[psalms 28 7|Psa.28:7]] (עָלַז), [[ezekiel 17 24|Eze.17:24]] (פָּרַח hi.), [[hosea 8 9|Hos.8:9]], Wis.4:4, Sir.5:1-15 * ;] to revive: [[philippians 4 10|Php.4:10]] (of MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀνάθεμα, -τος, τό (ἀνατίθημι), Hellenistic for Attic ἀνάθημα (Bl., § 27, 2); 1. prop. = τὸ ἀνατιθέμένον, that which is laid by to be kept, a votive offering (as ἀνάθημα in 2Ma.2:13, [[luke 21 5|Luk.21:5]]—where LT read -θεμα, see M, Pr., 46). 2. [As equiv. in LXX for חֵרֶם,] devoted, a thing devoted to God (see Driver, De., 98 f., and cf. [[leviticus 27 28|Lev.27:28-29]]), hence; (a) of the sentence pronounced ([[deuteronomy 13 15|Deu.13:15]]), a curse: [[acts 23 14|Act.23:14;]] (b) of the object on which the curse is laid, accursed ([[deuteronomy 7 26|Deu.7:26]]): [[romans 9 3|Rom.9:3]], [[1-corinthians 12 3|1Co.12:3 16:22]], [[galatians 1 8|Gal.1:8-9]] (see ICC on Ro.; Lft., Ga., ll. with; Cremer, 547; Tr., Syn., § v; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀνα-θεματίζω (ἀνίθεμα), [in LXX chiefly for חָרַם hi. ([[numbers 21 2|Num.21:2]], [[1-samuel 15 3|1Ki.15:3]], al.), 1Ma.5:5 ;] to devote to destruction, declare or invoke ana­thema: absol., [[mark 14 71|Mrk.14:71;]] ἐαντόν, to bind oneself under a curse: [[acts 23 12|Act.23:12, 14 23:21]] (cf. καταναθεματίζω, and on the occurrence of the word in π., see Deiss., LAE, 92 f.; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀνα-θεωρέω, -ῶ to observe carefully, consider well: [[acts 17 23|Act.17:23]], [[hebrews 13 7|Heb.13:7]] (Diod., al.).† (AS)

ἀνάθημα, -τος, τό (cf. ἀνάθημα, and see MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX often as seel. for ἀνάθεμα (חָרַם), and in [[numbers 21 3|Num.21:3]], [[judges 1 17|Jdg.1:17]] for חׇרְמָה, but prop. in 3Ma.3:17, al. ;] a gift set up in a temple, a votive offering: [[luke 21 5|Luk.21:5]] (LT, -θεμα).† (AS)
ἀναιδία (Rec. -εία, as in cl.), -ας, ἡ (αἰδώς), [in LXX: Sir.25:22 * ;] shamelessness, importunity: [[luke 11 8|Luk.11:8]] (for exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀν-αίρεσις, -εως, ἡ (ἀναιρέω), [in LXX: [[numbers 11 15|Num.11:15]] (הָרַג), [[judges 15 17|Jdg.15:17]] (רָמָה), Jdth.15:4, 2Ma.5:13 * ;] 1. a taking up or away (Thuc.). 2. a destroying, slaying, murder (Field, Notes, 116; MM, VGT, see word): [[acts 8 1|Act.8:1.]]† (AS)

ἀν-αιρέω, -ῶ [in LXX for הָרַג hi., מוּת hi., נָכָה hi., etc. ;] 1. to take up: mid., [[acts 7 21|Act.7:21.]] 2. to take away, make an end of, destroy (for late exx. of various senses, see MM, VGT, see word); (a) of things (as frequently in cl. of laws, etc.): [[hebrews 10 9|Heb.10:9;]] (b) of persons, to kill: [[matthew 2 16|Mat.2:16]], [[luke 22 2|Luk.22:2 23:32]], [[acts 2 23|Act.2:23 5:33, 36 7:28 9:23-24, 29 10:39 12:2 13:28 16:27 22:20 23:15, 21 23:27 25:3 26:10]], [[2-thessalonians 2 8|2Th.2:8]], WH, txt., R, txt.† (AS)

ἀν-αίτιος, -ον (αἰτία), [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 19 10|Deu.19:10, 13 21:8-9]] (נָקִי), Dan LXX TH Sus1:62, always of αἷμα (of. MM, VGT, see word)* ;] guiltless, innocent: [[matthew 12 5|Mat.12:5]], 7.† (AS)
ἀνα-καθ-ίζω (see: καθίζω); 1. trans., to set up. 2. Intrans., to sit up: [[luke 7 15|Luk.7:15]] (WH, mg., ἐκάθισεν), [[acts 9 40|Act.9:40]] (frequently in medical writings: MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)

ἀνα-καινίζω (καινός), [in LXX: [[2-chronicles 15 8|2Ch.15:8]], [[psalms 103 5|Psa.103:5 104:30]], [[lamentations 5 21|La 5:21]] (חָדַשׁ pi., hith)., [[psalms 39 2|Psa.39:2]] (עָכַר ni.), 1Ma.6:9 * ;] to renew: [[hebrews 6 6|Heb.6:6]] (Isocr., Plut.).† (AS)
ἀνα-καινόω, -ῶ = ἀνακαινίζω (cf. MM, VGT, see word), to make new: [[2-corinthians 4 16|2Co.4:16]], [[colossians 3 10|Col.3:10]] (see Cremer, 323).† (AS)

ἀνακαίνωσις, -εως, ἡ (ἀνακαινόω), renewal: [[romans 12 2|Rom.12:2]], [[titus 3 5|Tit.3:5]] (Cremer, 324; MM, VGT, see word).† SYN.: παλινγενεσία, in NT, new birth, of which ἀ. is the conse­quent renewal or renovation, in which man as well as God takes part (see Tr., Syn., § xviii) (AS)
ἀνα-καλύπτω [in LXX chiefly for גָּלָה ni., pi. ;] to unveil: metaphorically of removing hindrance to perception of spiritual things, [[2-corinthians 3 14|2Co.3:14 3:18]].† (AS)

ἀνα-κάμπτω [in LXX: [[1-chronicles 19 5|1Ch.19:5]], [[jeremiah 3 1|Jer.3:1]], al. (שׁוּב), [[jeremiah 15 5|Jer.15:5]] (סוּר) ;] 1. trans., to bend or turn back. 2. Intrans., to return: [[matthew 2 12|Mat.2:12]], [[acts 18 21|Act.18:21]], [[hebrews 11 15|Heb.11:15]]; metaphorically (cf. MM, VGT, see word), [[luke 10 6|Luk.10:6.]]† (AS)

ἀνά-κειμαι [in LXX: I [[esther 4 10|Est.4:10]], Tob.9:6 א * ;] 1. in cl., as pass. of ἀνατίθημ, to be laid up, laid: [[mark 5 40|Mrk.5:40]] Rec. 2. In late writers (cf. MM, VGT, see word) = κεῖσθαι, κατακεῖσθαι, to recline at table: [[matthew 26 20|Mat.26:20;]] part. ἀνακείμενος, [[matthew 9 10|Mat.9:10 22:10-11 26:7]], [[mark 6 26|Mrk.6:26 14:18 16:14]], [[luke 22 27|Luk.22:27]], [[john 6 11|Jhn.6:11 12:2 13:23, 28]].† SYN.: ἀνακλίνω, ἀναπίπτω, the latter denoting an act rather than a state and thus in [[john 13 25|Jhn.13:25]] differing from ἀνάκειμαι (see. [[john 13 23|Jhn.13:23]]) by indicating a change of position. (AS)

ἀνα-κεφαλαιόω, ῶ (see: κεφαλαιόω) [in Th., Al.: [[psalms 72 20|Psa.72:20]] * ;] to sum up, gather up, present as a whole: mid., [[romans 13 9|Rom.13:9]], [[ephesians 1 10|Eph.1:10]] (on WH. see Lft., Notes, 321 L; AR, in l; Cremer, 354, 748).† (AS)

ἀνα-κλίνω [in LXX: 3Ma.5:16 * ;] to lay upon, lean against, hence, (a) to lay down: [[luke 2 7|Luk.2:7;]] (b) to make to recline: [[mark 6 39|Mrk.6:39]], WH, mg., [[luke 12 37|Luk.12:37.]] Pass., to lie back, recline: [[matthew 8 11|Mat.8:11 14:19]], [[luke 13 29|Luk.13:29]].† SYN.: ἀνάκειμαι (which see), ἀναπίπτω (AS)
1. to drive back , (Odyssey by Homer) 2. to beat back an assailant, (Thucydides) 3. to stop:—; Pass. to be stopped, stop short , τινός from a thing, (Lucian) (ML)
ἀνα-κράζω [in LXX for קָרָא, etc. ;] to cry out, shout: [[mark 1 23|Mrk.1:23 6:49]], [[luke 4 33|Luk.4:33 8:28 23:18]].† (AS)

ἀνα-κρίνω [in LXX: [[1-samuel 20 12|1Ki.20:12]] (חָקַר), Dan LXX Su 1:13, LXX, TH Su 1:48, 51 * ;] to examine, investigate, question (Lft., Notes, 181 f.): [[acts 17 11|Act.17:11]], [[1-corinthians 2 14|1Co.2:14-15 4:3-4 9:3 10:25 10:27 14:24]]; in forensic sense (MM, VGT, see word; esp. of examination by torture; see Field, Notes, 120 f.), [[luke 23 14|Luk.23:14]], [[acts 4 9|Act.4:9 12:19 24:8 28:18]].† SYN.: see: ἐξετάζω (AS)
ἀνά-κρισις, -εως, ἡ [in LXX: 3Ma.7:5 * ;] an examination: spec. of legal preliminary investigation, [[acts 25 26|Act.25:26]] (see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

άνα-κύπτω [in LXX: [[job 10 15|Job.10:15]] (נָשָׂא רֹאשׁ), Dan LXX, Su 1:35 * ;] to lift oneself up; (a) bodily; [[luke 13 11|Luk.13:11]], [[john 8 7|Jhn.8:7, 10]]; (b) mentally, to be elated: [[luke 21 28|Luk.21:28]] (cf. MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀνα-λαμβάνω [in LXX chiefly for נָשָׂא, also for לָקַח, etc. ;] 1. to take up, raise: [[mark 16 19|Mrk.16:19]], [[acts 1 2|Act.1:2, 11 1:22 10:16]], [[1-timothy 3 16|1Ti.3:16]]. 2. to take up, take to oneself: [[acts 7 43|Act.7:43 20:13-14 23:31]], [[ephesians 6 13|Eph.6:13, 16]], [[2-timothy 4 11|2Ti.4:11]] (for late exx., v MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀνά-λημψις, -εως, ἡ (κοινή form of ἀνάληψις; see Th., Gr., 108 f.), a taking up: [[luke 9 51|Luk.9:51]] (MM, VGT, see word).† ἀνά-ληψις, -εως, ἡ, Rec. for ἀνάλημψις, which see (AS)

ἀν-αλίσκω (on the etymology, see MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX chiefly for אָכַל also for כָּלָה, etc. ;] 1. to expend. 2. to consume, destroy: [[luke 9 54|Luk.9:54]], [[galatians 5 15|Gal.5:15]], [[2-thessalonians 2 8|2Th.2:8]], Rec. WH, mg.† (AS)
ἀναλογία, -ας, ἡ (λόγος), [in Al.: [[leviticus 27 1|Lev.27:1-34]]"18 * ;] proportion (MM, VGT, see word): [[romans 12 6|Rom.12:6]] (cf. Cremer, 397).† (AS)
ἀνα-λογίζομαι [in LXX: Wis.17:13 א, 2Ma.12:43 A, 3Ma.7:7 * ;] to consider: [[hebrews 12 3|Heb.12:3]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἄναλος, -ον (ἅλς), [in Aq.: [[ezekiel 13 10|Eze.13:10-11, 15 22:28]] * ;] saltless, insipid: [[mark 9 50|Mrk.9:50.]]† (AS)
ἀνά-λυσις, -εως, ἡ (ἀναλύω), a loosing, e.g. of a vessel from its moorings, hence, departure: from life, [[2-timothy 4 6|2Ti.4:6.]]† (AS)

ἀνα-λύω [in LXX: I [[esther 3 3|Est.3:3]], Tob.2:9, Jdth.13:1, Sir.3:15, Wis.3:1-19 2:1-24,3 Mac.10 * ;] 1. to unloose. 2. to unloose for departure, depart (MM, VGT, see word): from life, [[philippians 1 23|Php.1:23]] 3. to return, [[luke 12 36|Luk.12:36.]]† (AS)

ἀναμάρτητος, -ον (ἁμαρτεῖν), [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 29 19|Deu.29:19]] (18) 2Ma.8:4 2Mac 12:42 * ;] 1. without missing, unerring (Xen.). 2. In moral sense, faultless (Plat.), without sin: [[john 8 7|Jhn.8:7]] (see Cremer, 102, 634; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀνα-μένω [in LXX for קָוָה pi. ;] to await "one whose coming is expected, perhaps with the added idea of patience and confidence" with accusative, [[1-thessalonians 1 10|1Th.1:10]] (see M, Th., in l; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀνα-μιμνήσκω [in LXX for זָכַר hi. ;] to remind, call to one's remembrance: with accusative of thing(s), [[1-corinthians 4 17|1Co.4:17;]] with inf., [[2-timothy 1 6|2Ti.1:6.]] Pass., to remember, call to mind: [[mark 11 21|Mrk.11:21 14:72]], [[2-corinthians 7 15|2Co.7:15]], [[hebrews 10 32|Heb.10:32]].† (AS)

ἀνάμνησις, -εως, ἡ (ἀναμιμνήσκω), [in LXX: [[psalms 38 1|Psa.38:1-22 70:1-5]] title. (זָכַר hi.), [[leviticus 24 7|Lev.24:7]] (אַזְכָּרָה), [[numbers 10 10|Num.10:10]] (זִכְרוֹן), Wis.16:6 * ;] remembrance: εἰς τ. ἐμὴν ἀ., [[luke 22 19|Luk.22:19]] (WH om.), [[1-corinthians 11 24|1Co.11:24-25;]] ἀ. ἁμαρτιῶν, [[hebrews 10 3|Heb.10:3]] (see Abbott, Essays, 122 ff.; DCG, ii, 74a).† SYN.: ὑπόμνησις (see Tr., Syn., § cvii). (AS)

ἀνα-νεόω, -ῶ (νέος), [in LXX: [[job 33 24|Job.33:24]], [[esther 3 13|Est.3:13]], 1; [[ezra 3 1|Ezr.3.1-13]], 4Ma.8:1-29 * ;] to renew: pass., [[ephesians 4 23|Eph.4:23]] (see Cremer, 428; MM, VGT, see word)† (AS)
ἀνα-νήφω to return to soberness: metaphorically, [[2-timothy 2 26|2Ti.2:26]] (of. ἐκνήφω).† (AS)

Ἀνανίας (WH, Ἁναν-), -α, ὁ (Heb. חֲנַנְיָה), Ananias; 1. of Jerusalem: [[acts 5 1|Act.5:1, 3 5:5]]. 2. Of Damascus: [[acts 9 10|Act.9:10-13, 17 22:12]]. 3. High Priest: [[acts 23 2|Act.23:2 24:1]].† (AS)

Ἀνανίας (WH, Ἁναν-), -α, ὁ (Heb. חֲנַנְיָה), Ananias; 1. of Jerusalem: [[acts 5 1|Act.5:1, 3 5:5]]. 2. Of Damascus: [[acts 9 10|Act.9:10-13, 17 22:12]]. 3. High Priest: [[acts 23 2|Act.23:2 24:1]].† (AS)

Ἀνανίας (WH, Ἁναν-), -α, ὁ (Heb. חֲנַנְיָה), Ananias; 1. of Jerusalem: [[acts 5 1|Act.5:1, 3 5:5]]. 2. Of Damascus: [[acts 9 10|Act.9:10-13, 17 22:12]]. 3. High Priest: [[acts 23 2|Act.23:2 24:1]].† (AS)
ἀν-αντί-ρητος (Τ, -ρρητος, -ον (ῥητός, spoken), [in Sm.: [[job 11 2|Job.11:2 33:13]] * ;] not to be contradicted, undeniable: [[acts 19 36|Act.19:36]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀν-αντι-ρήτως (T, -ρρήτως), adv., without contradiction: [[acts 10 29|Act.10:29.]]† (AS)

ἀν-άξιος, -ον (ἀ- neg., ἄξιος), [in LXX: [[jeremiah 15 19|Jer.15:19]] א2 (זָלַל), [[esther 8 13|Est.8:13]], Sir.25:8 * ;] unworthy: with genitive, [[1-corinthians 6 2|1Co.6:2]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀναξίως (see supr.), adv., [in LXX: 2Ma.14:42 * ;] in an unworthy manner: [[1-corinthians 11 27|1Co.11:27.]]† (AS)

ἀνά-παυσις, -εως, ή (ἀνάπαύω) [in LXX chiefly for נוּחַ and its derivatives, שַׁבָּת and its cognates (Ex, Le) ;] cessation, rest, refreshment: [[matthew 11 26|Mat.11:26 12:43]], [[luke 11 24|Luk.11:24]], [[revelation 4 8|Rev.4:8 14:11]].† SYN.: ἄνεσις (lit, the relaxation of the strings of a lyre), prop. signifies the rest or ease which comes from the relaxation of unfavour­able conditions, as, e.g. affliction: ἀνάπ., the rest which comes from the temporary cessation of labour (see Tr., Stn., § xl; Cremer, 827; MM, VGT, see word) (AS)

ἀνα-παύω, [in LXX for fourteen different words, chiefly נוּחַ, also רָבַץ, שָׁאַן, etc. ;] to give intermission from labour, to give rest, refresh: [[matthew 11 28|Mat.11:28]], [[1-corinthians 16 18|1Co.16:18]], Phm 20; pass., Phm 7, [[2-corinthians 7 13|2Co.7:13]]. Mid., to take rest, enjoy rest: [[matthew 26 45|Mat.26:45]], [[mark 6 31|Mrk.6:31 14:41]], [[luke 12 19|Luk.12:19]], [[revelation 6 11|Rev.6:11 14:13]]; as in Heb. ofIs 11:2 (עַל נוּחַ), τὸ πνεῦμα ἐφ᾽ ὑᾶμς ἀ., [[1-peter 4 14|1Pe.4:14.]] (In π. this word is used as a technical agricultural term; see MM, VGT, see word; and cf. Le 2634 f.; Cremer, 826.)† (AS)
ἀνα-πείθω [in LXX: [[jeremiah 29 8|Jer.29:8]] (נָשָׁא hi.), 1Ma.1:11 * ;] to per­suade, incite: [[acts 18 13|Act.18:13]] (cf. MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀνα-πέμπω 1. to send up, (a) to a higher place (Æsch., Plat., al.); (b) to a higher authority (Deiss., BS, 229; MM, VGT, see word; cf. also Field, Notes, 140): [[luke 23 7|Luk.23:7, 15]], [[acts 25 21|Act.25:21]]. 2. to send back (Pind.): [[luke 23 11|Luk.23:11]], Phm 11.† (AS)
ἀνά-πηρος (WH, -ειρος; see Field, Notes, 67), -ον (πηρός, maimed) [in LXX: Tob.14:2 א, 2Ma.8:24 * ;] maimed, crippled: [[luke 14 13|Luk.14:13, 21]].† (AS)

ἀνα-πίπτω [in LXX: [[genesis 49 9|Gen.49:9]] (כָּרַע) Tob.2:1 7:8, Jdth.12:10, Sir.25:18 32:2, Da TH Sus 1:37 * ;] 1. (cl.) to fall back. 2. In late writers = ἀνα-κλίνομαι, to recline for a repast (MM, VGT, see word): at table, [[luke 11 37|Luk.11:37 14:10 17:7 22:14]], [[john 13 12|Jhn.13:12 21:20]]; on the ground, [[matthew 15 35|Mat.15:35]] [[mark 6 40|Mrk.6:40 8:6]] [[john 6 10|Jhn.6:10]]; to lean back, [[john 13 25|Jhn.13:25]] (T, ἐπιπεσών; see: ἀνάκειμαι, ad fin.).† SYN.: ἀνάκειμαι (which see), ἀνακλίνομαι (AS)

ἀνα-πληρόω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא, [[leviticus 12 6|Lev.12:6]], al.; also שָׁלַם ([[genesis 15 16|Gen.15:16]], [[1-kings 7 51|3Ki.7:51]], [[isaiah 60 20|Isa.60:20]]), etc. ;] 1. to fill up, make full (in π. of com­pleting contracts and making up rent; cf. MM, VGT, see word): τόπον, take one's place (cf. Heb. מָקוֹם שָׁלַם), [[1-corinthians 14 16|1Co.14:16;]] άμαρτίας, complete the number, [[1-thessalonians 2 16|1Th.2:16;]] τ. νόμον, observe perfectly, [[galatians 6 2|Gal.6:2;]] pass., προφητεία, fulfilled, [[matthew 13 14|Mat.13:14.]] 2. to supply: τό ὑστέρημα, [[1-corinthians 16 17|1Co.16:17]], [[philippians 2 30|Php.2:30]] (Cremer, 838).† (AS)
ἀναπολόγητος, -ον (ἀπολογεόμαι), without excuse, inexcusable (in Polyb., al., as a forensic term; see Lft., Notes, 252): [[romans 1 20|Rom.1:20 2:1]].† (AS)
ἀνα-πτύσσω [in LXX for פָּרַשׂ,etc. ;] to unroll: τ. βιβλίον, [[luke 4 17|Luk.4:17]] (WH, R, ἀνοίξας).† (AS)
ἀν-άπτω [in LXX chiefly for יָצָא ;] to kindle: [[luke 12 49|Luk.12:49]], [[james 3 5|Jas.3:5]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀν-αρίθμητος, -ον (ἀριθμέω), [[[job 31 25|Job.31:25]], al.], innumerable: [[hebrews 11 12|Heb.11:12.]]† (AS)

ἀνα-σείω [in Aq.: [[1-kings 26 19|1Ki.26:19]], [[job 2 3|Job.2:3]]; Aq., Sm.: [[isaiah 36 18|Isa.36:18]] * ;] 1. to shake out, shake back, move to and fro (Thuc., a1.). 2. In late writers (Diod., al.; see MM, VGT, see word), to stir up; metaphorically, to excite: τ. ὄχλον, [[mark 15 11|Mrk.15:11;]] τ. λαόν, [[luke 23 5|Luk.23:5.]]† (AS)
ἀνα-σκευάζω (σκεῦος, a vessel), prop, to pack up baggage, hence, to dismantle, ravage, destroy; metaphorically, to unsettle, subvert (MM, VGT, see word): ψυχάς, [[acts 15 24|Act.15:24.]]† (AS)
ἀνα-σπάω, -ῶ [in LXX for לָקַח, עָלָה hi. ;] to draw up: [[luke 14 5|Luk.14:5]], [[acts 11 10|Act.11:10]] (in π. of pulling up barley; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀνά-στασις, -εως, ή (ἀνίστημι), [in LXX: [[zephaniah 3 8|Zep.3:8]] (קוּם), [[lamentations 3 63|La 3:63]] (קִימָה), קִימָה), [[psalms 66 1|Psa.66:1-20]] title., Dan LXX 11:20, 2Ma.7:14 2Mac 12:43 * ;] 1. a raising up, awakening, rising (in Inscr. of the erection of a monument, see MM, VGT, see word): [[luke 2 34|Luk.2:34.]] 2. a rising from the dead (see DCG, ii, 605b); (a) of Christ: [[acts 1 22|Act.1:22 2:31 4:33]] [[romans 6 5|Rom.6:5]], [[philippians 3 10|Php.3:10]], [[1-peter 3 21|1Pe.3:21]]; ἐξ ἀ. νεκρῶν, [[romans 1 4|Rom.1:4]] (ICC, in l); ἐκ νεκρῶν, [[1-peter 1 3|1Pe.1:3;]] (b) of persons in OT hist. (e.g. 3Ki.17:17 ff.): [[hebrews 11 35|Heb.11:35]]; (with) of the general resurrection: [[matthew 22 23|Mat.22:23, 28 22:30]] [[mark 12 18|Mrk.12:18, 23]] [[luke 20 27|Luk.20:27, 33 20:36]], [[john 11 24|Jhn.11:24]], [[acts 17 18|Act.17:18 23:8 24:15]], [[2-timothy 2 18|2Ti.2:18]]; ἀ. ἐκ νεκρῶν, [[luke 20 35|Luk.20:35]], [[acts 4 2|Act.4:2]]; τῶν νεκρῶν, [[matthew 22 31|Mat.22:31]], [[acts 17 32|Act.17:32 23:6 24:21 26:23]], [[1-corinthians 15 12|1Co.15:12-13 15:21 15:42]], [[hebrews 6 2|Heb.6:2]]; ἀ. ζωῆς, resurrection to life (cf. 2Ma.7:14, ἀ. εἰς ζωήν) and ἀ. τ. κρίσεως, τ. to judgment, [[john 5 29|Jhn.5:29;]] ἀ. τ. δικαίων, [[luke 14 14|Luk.14:14;]] κρείττων ἀ., [[hebrews 11 35|Heb.11:35;]] on ἡ ἀ. ἡ πρώτη, [[revelation 20 5|Rev.20:5-8]], see Swete, in l, Weste. on [[john 5 1|Jhn.5:1-47]], but see also Thayer, see word; by meton. of Christ as Author of ἀ., [[john 11 25|Jhn.11:25]] (see DB, iv, 231; Cremer, 307).† (AS)

ἀνα-στατόω, ῶ (ἀνάστατος, driven from home; ἀνίστημι), [in LXX: [[daniel 7 23|Dan.7:23]] (דּוּשׁ;* also in Aq., and in π. (see Deiss., LAE, 80 f.; MM, VGT, see word),] to stir up, excite, unsettle: with accusative; (a) to tumult and sedition: [[acts 17 6|Act.17:6 21:38]]; (b) by false teaching: [[galatians 5 12|Gal.5:12]] (see Milligan, NTD, 73 f.).† (AS)
ἀνα-σταυρόω 1. to impale (Hdt.). 2. to raise on a cross, crucify (Polyb., al.). 3. to crucify again: [[hebrews 6 6|Heb.6:6]] (see Westc., in l).† (AS)
ἀνα-στενάζω [in LXX: [[lamentations 1 4|La 1:4]] (אָנַח ni.), Sir.25:17), Da TH Sus 1:22, 2Ma.6:30 * ;] to sigh deeply: [[mark 8 12|Mrk.8:12.]]† (AS)

ἀνα-στρέφω [in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב ;] 1. to overturn: [[john 2 15|Jhn.2:15.]] 2. to turn back, return: [[acts 5 22|Act.5:22 15:16]]. 3. to turn hither and thither; pass., to turn oneself about, sojourn, dwell: [[matthew 17 22|Mat.17:22]] Rec.; metaphorically (like Heb. הָלַךְ, in κοινή writers and in π.; see Deiss., LAE, 315; BS, 88, 194; MM, VGT, see word), to conduct oneself, behave, live: [[2-corinthians 1 12|2Co.1:12]], [[ephesians 2 3|Eph.2:3]], [[1-timothy 3 15|1Ti.3:15]], [[hebrews 10 33|Heb.10:33 13:18]], [[1-peter 1 17|1Pe.1:17]], [[2-peter 2 18|2Pe.2:18]]. † SYN.: περιπατέω (Hellenistic), πολιτεύω (AS)

ἀνα-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀναστρέφομαι) [in LXX: Tob.4:14, 2Ma.5:8 2Mac 6:23 * ;] 1. a turning down or back, a wheeling about (Soph., Thuc., al.). 2. In late writers (Polyb., al.; see: ἀναστρέφω, and cf. Hort on [[james 3 13|Jas.3:13;]] MM, VGT, see word), manner of life, behaviour, conduct: [[galatians 1 13|Gal.1:13]], [[ephesians 4 22|Eph.4:22]], [[1-timothy 4 12|1Ti.4:12]], [[hebrews 13 7|Heb.13:7]], [[james 3 13|Jas.3:13]], [[1-peter 1 15|1Pe.1:15 1:18 2:12 3:1-2 3:16]], [[2-peter 2 7|2Pe.2:7 3:11]].† (AS)

ἀνα-τάσσομαι [in LXX only as seel. (Ald.) in [[ecclesiastes 2 20|Ecc.2:20]] ;] to arrange in order, bring together from memory (Blass., Phil. Gosp., 14 ff.; MM, VGT, see word): [[luke 1 1|Luk.1:1.]]† (AS)

ἀνα-τέλλω [in LXX for צָמַח, פָּרַח, זָרַח, etc. ;] 1. trans., to cause to rise: [[matthew 5 45|Mat.5:45.]] 2. Intrans., to rise: φῶς, [[matthew 4 16|Mat.4:16]] (= [[isaiah 9 1|Isa.9:1]]); ὁ ἥλιος, [[matthew 13 6|Mat.13:6]], [[mark 4 6|Mrk.4:6 16:2]], [[james 1 11|Jas.1:11]]; νεφέλη, [[luke 12 54|Luk.12:54;]] φωσφόρος, [[2-peter 1 19|2Pe.1:19;]] ὁ Κύριος, prob. with ref. to metaphorically of sun or star, [[hebrews 7 14|Heb.7:14]] (cf. ἐξ-ανατέλλω).† (AS)

ἀνα-τίθημι [in LXX chiefly for חָרַם (Cremer, 546) ;] to lay upon, set up, etc. Mid. -εμαι, in late writers (Plut., al.; see also MM, VGT, see word), to set forth, declare: [[acts 25 14|Act.25:14]], [[galatians 2 2|Gal.2:2]].† (AS)

ἀνατολή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀνατέλλω), [in LXX chiefly for מִזְרָח קָדִים ;] 1. a rising: of light, [[luke 1 78|Luk.1:78.]] 2. the sun-rising, the east (MM, VGT, see word): [[matthew 2 2|Mat.2:2]], 9, [[revelation 21 13|Rev.21:13]]; ἀ. ἡλίου, [[revelation 7 2|Rev.7:2 16:12]] (WΗ, p1.); pl., [[matthew 2 1|Mat.2:1 8:11 24:27]], [[luke 13 29|Luk.13:29]].† (AS)

ἀνα-τρέπω [in LXX for דָּחָה, הָדַף, etc. ;] to overturn, destroy: [[john 2 15|Jhn.2:15]] WH, txt.; metaphorically, to subvert (MM, VGT, see word): [[2-timothy 2 18|2Ti.2:18]], [[titus 1 11|Tit.1:11]].† (AS)
ἀνα-τρέφω [in LXX: Wis.7:4 B, 4Ma.10:2 4Mac 11:15 א* ;] to nurse up, nourish, educate, bring up: [[luke 4 16|Luk.4:16]], WΗ, mg., [[acts 7 20|Act.7:20-21 22:3]].† (AS)

ἀνα-φαίνομαι [in LXX for צָדַק hi., גָּלַשׁ ;] to bring to light, make to appear: ἀναφάναντες τ. Κύπρον, i.e. having sighted C.: [[acts 21 3|Act.21:3]] WH; pass., to appear, be made manifest: [[luke 19 11|Luk.19:11]] (AS)

ἀνα-φέρω [in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi., also for קָטַר hi., etc. ;] 1. to carry or lead up: with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 17 1|Mat.17:1]], [[mark 9 2|Mrk.9:2]]; pass., [[luke 24 51|Luk.24:51]] (WH, rejects, R, mg. omits); ἀ. τ. ἁμαρτίας ἐπί τ. ξύλον (see Deiss., 135, 88 f.; ICC, in l; MM, VGT, see word): [[1-peter 2 24|1Pe.2:24.]] 2. In LXX and NT, to bring to the altar, to offer (see Hort on 1Pe, l.with): θυσίας, etc., [[hebrews 7 27|Heb.7:27 13:15]], [[1-peter 2 5|1Pe.2:5]]; ἐπί τ. θυσιαστήριον, [[james 2 21|Jas.2:21]] (see Mayor, in l). 3. to bear, sustain (cf. [[numbers 14 33|Num.14:33]], [[isaiah 53 12|Isa.53:12]]): [[hebrews 9 28|Heb.9:28]].† (AS)
